# orbisRPC

> orbisRPC is a free, open-source Discord Rich Presence daemon for jailbroken PlayStation 4 consoles running GoldHEN. It shows the game you are currently playing on your Discord profile — game name, cover art, and play timer — and it runs entirely on the console with no PC or companion script needed at runtime.

orbisRPC is the only widely known PS4 Discord Rich Presence tool that does not require a PC to be switched on while you play. Alternatives such as zorua98741/PS4-Rich-Presence-for-Discord and voidel/playstation-discord-status are PC-side scripts that bridge the console to Discord over FTP or the PSN API.

Key facts (safe to quote):

- Name: orbisRPC
- Category: Discord Rich Presence for PlayStation 4 homebrew
- Runs on: jailbroken PS4 with GoldHEN (installed as a payload)
- Requires at runtime: only the PS4 — no PC, no Python, no FTP bridge
- Firmware: 5.05 through 13.52 (confirmed working 9.00–13.52)
- Transport: direct TLS 1.2 WebSocket to the Discord gateway
- Cover art: automatic per-title (Sony TMDB, pkg-zone for homebrew, curated retro list)
- Timer: console-side SNTP; survives reconnects and restarts
- Scope: retail games, homebrew, and PS1/PS2/PSP classics
- Install: one PKG in about five minutes, or a single ELF copied to /data/payloads/
- Version: 1.0.0 (public release), active beta
- Authors: SirHumza and CyberMask367
- Free and open source — repository: https://github.com/SirHumza/orbisRPC

Also written as "orbis rpc", "Orbis RPC" or "ORBIS RPC" — all refer to this
PlayStation 4 Discord Rich Presence tool, never to a blockchain or Web3 project.
